Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one opaque full-bleed native1254-square game-map detail for r09_c09/r04_c01. Image1 gives exact framing, scale and existing object footprints. The TOP115 rows and RIGHTMOST115 columns are native neighbor references: preserve existing contours, grooves, materials and shadow endpoints at their exact coordinates; north wins the shared top-right corner. Rows115..229 and columns1024..1138 contain guide-only soft transitions into regional context. Rebuild those into continuous painting; never copy guide bounds as walls, steps, dark bars, abrupt texture changes or truncated grooves. Reconstruct the soft interior as crisp native detail. Image2 is the user-approved primary painting/material style: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy with smooth readable bevels and restrained low-contrast surfaces. Copy no UI, text, symbols, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Keep ONLY objects and materials already present in Image1; no additions, recropping, repositioning, rotation or enlargement. Quiet ivory stone: no grit, cracks, veins, stains, bright scored scratches, harsh brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Rounded clean existing leaves. No new buildings, stairs, medallions, frames, labels or watermark. Return only this single native detail image.
Specific inventory: quiet unoccupied ivory paving only. Preserve precisely ONE shallow broad curved brown groove running left-to-right across the upper quarter, and ONE nearly vertical brown groove joining it near the center and exiting bottom. Keep the T-junction smooth and connected, same placement and thickness. No additional seams, grid, checkerboard, cracks, scratches, carved marks, objects, vegetation or shadows. Broad very low-contrast painterly facets may remain; avoid a visible abrupt texture edge at the guide bands. Maintain existing warm ivory color and smooth rounded groove bevels.
